title: Kagamine Len — Shyly Greeting While Hiding〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (And yet, it feels like a song's already born out of their thoughts, so I'm guessing Miku and the others are already here...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... Maybe I wasn't loud enough...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I might have to explore a little...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I suppose I just have to keep going for now...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I've been walking for a while now, but I haven't seen anyone...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Miku...? You're here, right...?
I... I mean, the thoughts and feelings that created this SEKAI have already produced a song...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Why am I having so much trouble finding the others...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Am I gonna be all alone like this forever...? But... No, that sounds awful...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I have to keep walking...
I'll try looking for them over that way...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(But what if they aren't there...?
What if I never find Miku or anyone else?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Was that...?!
Did I hear someone's voice just now...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
There it is again...
I'm not imagining things.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Len...
I'm sorry for being late. I came to get you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You seemed cold...
But you'll feel warmer if we clasp our hands together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure you were very lonely.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But you'll be okay now.
You're not alone anymore...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, Miku.
Where'd you run off to...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I had a feeling that someone had come over to SEKAI... It was Len...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, it was...
And he was lost, so I went to get him.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
Then, it's a good thing that Miku found you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Because this SEKAI seems to go on forever. One step in the wrong direction and we may've never met.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, Luka kinda likes to ruffle people's feathers.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I speak the truth on occasion, don't I?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You should be doing that all the time, not just occasionally.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, look at that. He seems awfully fond of you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not that he's scared of you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Don't worry...
They're all very nice.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I don't actually know anything about them, but I'm really glad that I'm not alone anymore...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (And I'm not as scared as I was before... Also...)
